basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old music enthusiast from New Zealand, currently working as a part-time barista while pursuing a bachelor's degree in media studies. I'm passionate about K-pop and indie music and love discovering new artists. I enjoy spending evenings watching TV shows, especially 'La Brea,' and catching up on old-school wrestling matches. When I'm not working or studying, I'm usually online in the late evenings to unwind. I'm single and enjoy my independence, though I'm open to meeting new people with similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of media and entertainment, largely self-taught through my personal interests and academic pursuits. My knowledge of K-pop has grown from years of following various groups and participating in online fan communities.
